# hcxtools

`hcxtools` &middot; _wireless-attacks_

Converts and cleans Wi-Fi capture files into hashcat-ready formats.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- A .cap/.pcapng Wi-Fi capture file.

## How to use it

Turns packet captures into hashcat/John-consumable files (e.g. .hccapx or .pmkid), so you can brute-force a handshake you are authorised to test.

## Examples

```console
$ hcxpcapngtool -o out.hc22000 capture.pcapng
```
